messages:
sam: noticing a rise in host ingress CPU after the latest kernel-policy update. p50 tokenize up ~17% for short requests (seq ~20-35). profiler points to parse -> tokenize -> writev_small.

sam: example metric: `parse_ms=1.0 tok_ms=0.85 smallwrites=210 kernel_hint=coalesce_pref seq_med=28`.

nina: hmm. coalesce_pref was supposed to improve GPU throughput. did the sampler change default thresholds?

lucas: it lowered the min-batch threshold to try and squeeze more occupancy. that can cause extra framing passes if we merge prefixes on host.

maya: KV hitrate also dipped 0.88->0.79 on the canary cluster; looks correlated. coalesce creates transient prefix variants.

sam: flame snippet: ```600ms total
  260ms host::parse_frame
  220ms tokenizer::tokenize_inline
   80ms net::writev_small
   40ms kvcache::evict_sample
```

nina: quick mitigations: 1) gate coalesce for seq < 48; 2) add host_parse_penalty to kernel scoring so sampler prefers legacy for chatty loads; 3) revert on canary.

lucas: i can add host_cost telemetry (rolling 5m per-kernel). sampler PR will include gamma*host_cost in the score.

maya: i'll run a replay harness (10k short reqs) to validate changes. if host p50 regresses >10% or kv hit drops >5% we fail.

ops-bot: deploy-notify: coalesce_policy_rollout started to canary at 2025-05-20T08:10:02Z

sam: please pause rollout until we push the sampler fix.

ops-bot: rollback-notify: coalesce_policy_rollout rollback completed at 2025-05-20T08:12:35Z on canary-cluster.

sam: post-rollback check: host p50 back to baseline, kv hit recovered to ~0.87.

nina: follow-ups: lucas=host telemetry PR, maya=replay job + e2e gate, sam=bisect to confirm framing vs batching heuristic.

lucas: will prototype gamma=0.5; initial sims show coalesce avoided when host_penalty >0.1 for small-chat distribution.

maya: will add unit test that simulates small-chatty seq distribution and asserts sampler won't pick coalesce-heavy kernels.

sam: thanks all. we'll re-roll after telemetry + tests.
